files.content:
# Examples/Linear command palette

A Linear command palette: search and grid only, no tabs and no preview.

Install the v5 emoji-picker-react candidate, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="linear-picker" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
